errors.text: The proposed irradiation intervention does not reconstruct the target intervention of inducing controlled chemical short-range order in a random bcc alloy.

The predicted decrease is opposite to the target result: short-range ordering increases lattice thermal conductivity by about 12% through reduced lattice distortion and percolative ordered-cluster pathways.
The falsification experiment measures only total thermal conductivity and therefore cannot establish a change in phonon thermal conductivity when electronic and phonon contributions are comparable.
The hypothesis conflates pristine and 1 wt.% oxygen-containing material states and extends the claim from nearly 0 to 1200 K without state-specific evidence.
